# PopCount <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PopCount:Int32 value:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | In | Int32 | required | An integer. |

**Returns:** How many bits are 1.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Counts the bits of a number that are 1. This is a BlitzLLVM extension. It looks at the bits of the number the way its type has them, so the same value counts differently as a `Byte`, an `Int` or a `Long`: a number written in the program is an `Int` (32 bits) unless it is larger, and `Byte`, `UByte`, `Short`, `UShort`, `UInt`, `Long` and `ULong` give the other widths. A real or a text is taken as an `Int`, like the bit operators do.

## Differences

* Not in the originals.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print PopCount(255)
Print PopCount(-1)
Print PopCount(Byte(-1))
Print PopCount(ULong(-1))
```

```text
8
32
8
64
```
